description: A green dome flecked with moss, still cool. The forest blobs leave one behind every time they lose.
lore: Cool for hours, and it will not take heat off a hand, which is the only property in this whole part of the trade that a person can actually use. [[characters/cfe826c1|Jehanne]] keeps a crock of them by her fire and puts one on a burn, a barked knuckle, a blister off a bad boot, the way somebody's grandmother did it. Whether any of that is needed here is a question she has stopped raising, on the same reasoning as everything else she still does: the hand hurts, the hand goes cool, the person sits down and stays a while. Seven gold the crock. The wood restocks it every time it loses.
gm_notes: Jehanne's practice in miniature — a remedy she cannot prove is needed, kept up because it makes somebody sit down at a fire. Same logic as her rite, one crock smaller.
